description: Implementation of NamedTensor mode and related functions in PyTorch, managing tensor names and metadata.

classes.name: NamesMode
classes.description: Manages enabling/disabling of named tensor mode.

classes.name: NamedTensorMeta
classes.description: Stores metadata for named tensors, including names.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether named tensor mode is enabled.

methods.name: set_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables named tensor mode.

methods.name: internal_set_names_inplace
methods.description: Sets tensor names in-place, with validation.

methods.name: check_unique_names
methods.description: Checks for duplicate names in a list.

methods.name: check_names_valid_for
methods.description: Validates names for a given tensor or dimension.

methods.name: get_named_tensor_meta
methods.description: Retrieves named tensor metadata from tensor implementation.

methods.name: get_names
methods.description: Gets tensor names, defaulting if none are set.

methods.name: has_names
methods.description: Checks if tensor has named metadata and mode is enabled.
